questions.prompt: By whatever way you go, by that way I shall follow you.
questions.answer: Quā viā ībis, eā tē sequar.

questions.prompt: By that road the idle crowd wandered, while the soldiers hurried by this one.
questions.answer: Illāc turba ōtiōsa vagābātur, dum mīlitēs hāc properābant.

questions.prompt: By some path the beaten enemy slipped away through the woods.
questions.answer: Aliquā viā hostis superātus per silvās ēlāpsus est.

questions.prompt: Where the road narrows, there the horses advance slowly.
questions.answer: Quā via angustātur, ibi equī tardē prōgrediuntur.

questions.prompt: Where the enemy had pitched camp, there we found abundant water.
questions.answer: Ubi hostēs castra posuerant, ibi aquam abundantem invēnimus.

questions.prompt: Whither the general marched, thither the weary soldiers followed.
questions.answer: Quō dux contendit, illūc mīlitēs fessī secūtī sunt.

questions.prompt: By this way we came, by that way we shall return home.
By this way the army marched, by that way the cavalry rode.
questions.answer: Hāc exercitus iter fēcit, illāc equitēs vectī sunt.

questions.prompt: Here the temple once stood; there the forum was crowded with citizens.
questions.answer: Hīc templum ōlim stetit; illīc forum cīvibus frequēns erat.

questions.prompt: By some way the fugitives escaped from the burning city.
questions.answer: Aliquā fugitīvī ex urbe ārdente effūgērunt.
